assertions.title: Transcription started from /c/new cleans up draft state and stays appendable

steps.action: Open /c/new unauthenticated, then login as val-user and return to /c/new
steps.expected: Reach draft composer state on /c/new for transcription start
steps.observed: Redirected to /login?redirect_to=%2Fc%2Fnew, then login succeeded and browser landed on /c/new

steps.action: Upload audio file from /c/new and click Transcribe
steps.expected: Draft file/preview state is cleared after handoff, navigates to transcript conversation, and conversation remains appendable for normal follow-up chat
steps.observed: Transcribe handoff navigated to /c/f3b5f9d2-b9d0-4258-9a95-257f66f8be9d with request+transcript messages visible, but auth-ban responses started immediately afterward and blocked the required follow-up checks for draft cleanup and appendable-chat verification

assertions.issues: Could not complete the required post-handoff checks (source /c/new draft-file cleanup + explicit appendable follow-up chat send) because all seeded personas became temporarily banned during the same validation window.

assertions.title: Deleting an in-flight transcript does not break later transcription jobs

steps.action: Prepare to queue transcription and delete transcript conversation/message mid-run
steps.expected: Delete in-flight transcript artifacts, then verify later transcription jobs still process
steps.observed: Could not proceed after first transcription because authenticated API/UI actions began returning temporary-ban responses

steps.action: Attempt alternate seeded personas for continuation
steps.expected: Recover authenticated session and continue in-flight deletion scenario
steps.observed: val-superadmin and val-workspace-admin login attempts also returned temporary-ban responses

assertions.issues: In-flight deletion and follow-up-job assertions were not testable because authenticated sessions could not be maintained or re-established after temporary-ban enforcement.

assertions.title: Background transcription remains a persistent conversation workflow, not a one-shot upload side effect

steps.action: From /c/new, upload audio and explicitly click Transcribe
steps.expected: Transcription starts only via explicit user action and immediately creates persistent conversation
steps.observed: Transcribe button became visible after upload and click transitioned from /c/new to /c/f3b5f9d2-b9d0-4258-9a95-257f66f8be9d with transcription messages

steps.action: Verify ongoing progress metadata and normal follow-up-chat continuity after completion
steps.expected: Background-runner progress states remain observable and conversation behaves like normal chat post-transcription
steps.observed: Could not finish this verification because auth-ban responses blocked subsequent authenticated checks and additional transcription cycles

evidence.network: POST /api/auth/login (val-user) -> 200; GET /api/files (same session token) -> 403 temporary-ban; later persona login attempts -> 403 temporary-ban

assertions.issues: Cross-flow was only partially observed before auth-ban enforcement prevented completion of the progress-metadata and post-completion follow-up-chat checks.

frictions.description: agent-browser element refs were blocked by an open attach popup when trying to click Transcribe.
frictions.resolution: Pressed Escape to dismiss the popup and retried the click successfully.

frictions.description: agent-browser network request capture returned 'No requests captured' even after successful login/transcribe interactions.
frictions.resolution: Used curl/API probes and saved explicit status-code evidence files for request outcomes.

blockers.description: Seeded validation personas were all rejected with temporary-ban responses during this run.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Switched from val-user to val-superadmin and val-workspace-admin, but login remained blocked with the same temporary-ban message.

summary: Tested 3 assigned assertions on dev rail: 0 passed, 0 failed, 3 blocked. Partial transcription workflow behavior was observed (explicit Transcribe action created a persistent conversation), but auth temporary-ban enforcement blocked completion of required persistence assertions.
